description: This dataset comprises digitized whole slide images (WSIs) of brain histology immunostained for β-amyloid (Aβ) plaques, including 63 WSIs and more than 70,000 annotated plaque regions. The annotations distinguish between cored and diffuse plaques as well as cerebral amyloid angiopathy, providing a comprehensive resource for Alzheimer’s disease pathology research.

This dataset includes 50 breast cancer whole slide images (WSIs) stained with H&E and paired IHC, annotated with tumor regions and Ki67 hotspots, as well as 31 PAS-stained kidney biopsy WSIs containing 2,340 cropped glomerulus images classified as normal or sclerotic.

A comprehensive genome-wide atlas of gene expression in the adult mouse brain, featuring high-resolution in situ hybridization section images for approximately 20,000 genes, as well as whole slide images (WSIs) and annotations. This resource, provided by the Allen Institute for Brain Science, supports studies in brain histopathology and neuroscience, and is publicly available at https://mouse.brain-map.org.

A lung cancer histopathology dataset from the ACDC@LungHP 2019 challenge, consisting of 200 H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) with pixel-wise annotated tumor regions, designed for automatic cancer detection, classification, and segmentation in lung histopathology.
The AMIDA 2013 breast cancer mitosis detection challenge dataset comprises H&E histology high-power field images, featuring over 1000 annotated mitotic figure locations for detection evaluation.
PAS-stained kidney whole slide image (WSI) dataset featuring segmented glomeruli, each labeled as either normal (1,170) or sclerotic (1,170).

Automatic registration of paired H&E and IHC whole slide images (WSIs) for multimodal landmark-based registration in breast cancer, utilizing a dataset of 1150 cases, each comprising one H&E slide matched to up to four IHC slides (ER, PR, HER2, KI67), with landmark annotations provided for accurate image alignment.
The dataset comprises approximately 8,617 pathology images curated from textbooks and journals, each accompanied by detailed expert-written captions.
This colorectal cancer histology dataset contains images categorized into three classes: normal mucosa, low-grade dysplasia, and high-grade dysplasia.

The Breast Core Needle Biopsy (BCNB) dataset consists of 1058 H&E-stained breast core biopsy whole slide images (WSIs) with annotated tumor regions, accompanied by clinical data including patient lymph node metastasis outcomes for binary classification.

The ICIAR 2018 BACH challenge dataset includes 400 H&E-stained breast histology image patches (100 for each class: normal, benign, in situ carcinoma, and invasive carcinoma) along with 10 whole-slide images containing tumor annotations.

The BEST2/3 Cytosponge trial pathology dataset comprises approximately 3,350 minimally invasive esophageal cytology samples for Barrett’s esophagus screening, featuring ThinPrep whole slide images (WSIs) that include both digitized H&E and TFF3-stained immunohistochemistry (IHC) slides. Around 300 of these slides have expert-annotated Barrett’s esophagus regions.

The Breast Cancer Semantic Segmentation (BCSS) dataset comprises 155 whole-slide images (WSIs) of breast cancer, including 151 TCGA breast cancer WSIs, with over 20,000 annotated tissue regions across five categories such as tumor epithelium, stroma, inflammatory, necrosis, and more, providing comprehensive region-level annotations for breast histopathology semantic segmentation tasks.

A high-resolution digital brain atlas platform and online repository featuring multi-species whole-brain histology images totaling over 50 TB, with a zoomable JP2/Deep Zoom viewer for detailed exploration.

This breast cancer cell classification dataset comprises 120 H&E-stained image patches from 113 patients (sourced from TCGA), with dot annotations marking lymphocytes, tumor/epithelial, and stromal cells for multi-class cell detection.

The Breast Carcinoma Subtyping dataset comprises 547 H&E-stained whole-slide breast histology images and 4539 region-of-interest patches from 189 patients, annotated for subtype classification across 7 lesion classes.

A dataset of approximately 2,400 H&E image patches from post-neoadjuvant breast cancer whole slide images (WSIs), each annotated by pathologists with tumor cellularity scores, collected from 33 patients.

A large breast tumor subtyping dataset with over 550 annotated H&E whole slide images (WSIs) spanning benign, atypia, and malignant lesions across six subtypes, designed for risk group and subtype classification.
An ultra-high resolution 3D human brain histology atlas created from 7,404 Nissl-stained histological sections, offering 20 µm isotropic resolution (~1 TB volume).

A dataset of 177 colorectal adenoma whole slide images (WSIs) from PLA General Hospital, each with slide-level adenoma annotations and accompanied by 1280×1280 image crops suitable for weakly-supervised learning.

A comprehensive skin pathology WSI dataset comprising over 7,000 FFPE whole slide images (WSIs) covering basal cell carcinoma, melanoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and Merkel cell carcinoma, designed for skin cancer classification and segmentation tasks.

dataset_name: CCEDD - Cervical Cell Edge Detection Dataset
description: 686 high-resolution Pap smear images with expert-annotated cervical cell edge detection labels.

A breast histopathology dataset comprising 7,909 image patches from 82 patients, captured at four magnifications (40×, 100×, 200×, 400×), with each image labeled as benign or malignant and further categorized into four subtypes per class.

A merged dataset of 1,399 H&E-stained lymph node whole slide images (WSIs) from Camelyon16 and Camelyon17, each with slide-level metastasis labels and tumor region annotations, designed for tumor detection and classification tasks.

A large colorectal biopsy patch dataset containing 9,857 H&E-stained patches from 63 patients, each labeled with one of four carcinoma differentiation grades, and accompanied by a WSI test set for validation.

A cervical Pap smear cytology dataset comprising 93 image stacks with multi-frame extended depth-of-field (EDF) images, each labeled as Negative, LSIL, or HSIL, and including 2,705 annotated nuclei with nucleus detection point annotations across the cases.

A multi-modality microscopy cell segmentation dataset featuring challenge-level, expert-annotated instance masks and classifications of nuclei in histology and immunofluorescence (IF) images from diverse tissue types.

A colon histology image patch dataset containing colorectal patches with nuclei annotations for segmentation, classification, and cellular composition estimation, featuring approximately 431,000 annotated nuclei across 4,981 patches from 16 patients.
A multimodal brain tumor dataset comprising 388 glioma patients, each with paired pathology whole slide images (WSIs) and MRI scans, labeled for glioma subtypes.

dataset_name: CPTAC-CCRCC The Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Collection
description: Whole-slide H&E pathology images of clear cell renal cell carcinoma from 262 patients in the CPTAC proteogenomics cohort, including both tumor and auxiliary non-CCRCC slides.
A total of 642 H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) from breast cancer patients in the CPTAC BRCA cohort, including cases with proteomic-genomic links, are available via TCIA.
H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) of bone marrow biopsies, bone marrow smears, and blood specimens from 88 AML patients as part of the CPTAC AML cohort.
Whole-slide H&E images of lung adenocarcinoma from 244 patients in the CPTAC proteogenomic cohort, provided alongside radiology and proteomic data.

dataset_name: CPTAC-COAD: The Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium Colon Adenocarcinoma Collection
description: Whole-slide H&E pathology images of colon adenocarcinoma from 106 patients in the CPTAC proteogenomic cohort, linked with comprehensive proteomic and genomic data.
H&E whole-slide images of high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma from 102 patients in the CPTAC cohort, collected as part of the Phase 2 proteogenomic study.
Whole-slide pathology images from multiple CPTAC cancer cohorts, encompassing various cancer types, are available through TCIA.
Labeled H&E image patches of cutaneous spindle cell neoplasms, crowdsourced from experts and trainees, for WSI-level benign vs malignant classification.
A dataset of 280,000 colorectal biopsy image patches, each labeled for one of seven distinct tissue phenotypes.
Whole-slide H&E images of uterine corpus endometrial carcinoma from 250 patients in the CPTAC Phase 3 cohort, provided for proteogenomic studies.
A dataset of 100,000 H&E-stained colorectal histology image patches, each categorized into one of nine distinct tissue classes.
A dataset of 5,000 colorectal cancer image tiles, each labeled into one of eight tissue categories, designed for texture analysis.
Colorectal adenocarcinoma regions annotated with nuclear features for phenotype classification.

A web-based platform providing cell image collections for cytopathology research, featuring the CRIC Cervix Pap smear dataset with over 11,000 cervical cell annotations for detection and classification benchmarks.
Formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded (FFPE) hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) whole slide images (WSIs) of lung adenocarcinoma, labeled according to the predominant histologic pattern.

A dataset of 100 H&E whole slide images (WSIs) of colorectal biopsies, each labeled at the slide level with dysplasia grades and carcinoma for classification, and containing approximately 1 million annotated tiles.

A subset of the CRIC dataset consisting of 400 Pap smear microscopy images, each containing individually outlined and labeled cervical cells, with a total of 11,534 cells classified into six Bethesda system categories.

The first fully-annotated cryosection nuclei segmentation dataset, featuring instance masks for approximately 8,000 nuclei and nuclei annotations for segmentation and tumor/normal classification, derived from 30 frozen tissue patches across 10 different organs.

A prostate cancer histopathology dataset comprising 4,675 H&E-stained whole slide images (WSIs) labeled for carcinoma presence (binary) across three cohorts—including fully annotated slides, slide-level diagnoses, and a multi-reader set with 46 WSIs annotated by 9 pathologists for consensus—and featuring over 2.6 million extracted patch images for tumor detection.

dataset_name: EBRAINS Digital Brain Tumour Atlas (TCGA-TIL study)
description: A comprehensive resource comprising 873 FFPE glioma whole-slide images labeled for IDH mutation status (mutant vs wildtype) and 4,759 TCGA H&E whole-slide images representing 13 brain tumor types, each accompanied by corresponding tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte density maps.
91 whole-slide images (H&E) from endometrial pipelle biopsies with consensus grades for carcinoma detection and grading, as determined by 15 pathologists.

A colorectal cancer biopsy image dataset comprising 5,532 H&E-stained images of colorectal specimens captured at four magnifications (including 200×), with each image labeled across five tumor grade classes: polyp, low-grade intraepithelial neoplasia (IN), high-grade IN, serrated adenoma, and adenocarcinoma.
A dataset of 212 Pap-stained breast fine-needle aspiration cytology (FNAC) smear images labeled for benign vs malignant classification.

dataset_name: Gastric Cancer Histopathology Tissue Image Dataset
description: A dataset of approximately 31,096 H&E image tiles (patches) from 300 gastric cancer whole-slide images (WSIs), each with pixel-level annotations labeling one of 8 tissue component classes within the tumor microenvironment.
A dataset of 58 H&E-stained breast histology images, each accompanied by nuclei masks, categorized into benign and malignant cases.

dataset_name: Dryad IDC Breast Cancer Patch Dataset
description: A set of 277,524 histology image patches (50×50 px) extracted from 162 formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) breast biopsy whole-slide images (WSIs), each labeled as IDC-positive or IDC-negative to indicate the presence or absence of invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC).
An open-source set of 700 H&E-stained gastric histology field images, labeled as cancerous or non-cancerous, designed for gastric cancer classification and detection model research.

A subset of the ICPR2012 MITOS dataset scanned on a Hamamatsu scanner, providing breast cancer whole slide images (WSIs) with expert annotations of mitotic figures in high-power fields (HPFs) for mitosis detection algorithm training.

A benchmark dataset of high-resolution placental H&E whole-slide images with hierarchical annotations for healthy and infarcted term placentas, as well as various placental pathologies, to assist automated diagnosis.

A collection of bone marrow biopsy histology images from 16 patients (H&E, 40× magnification), converted into 28×28 grayscale patches for generative modeling, comprising 6,800 training, 2,000 validation, and 2,000 test patches.

A set of breast cancer whole-slide H&E images with known HER2 status labels, released for the HEROHE challenge, comprising training and test splits of HER2-positive and -negative cases for HER2 status prediction from H&E images.
A set of segmented cervical cell images from Pap smears, classified into seven cell types, designed for cytology research and classifier training.

A multimodal dataset of human tissue comprising paired H&E whole-slide images and spatial transcriptomics across 26 organs, including H&E stained breast tumor patches graded by nuclear atypia on a scale of 1 to 3 for grading algorithm development.

A comprehensive multi-center cervical dataset featuring single-cell Pap smear images across 29 cytology classes, along with high-resolution cervical histopathology whole slide images (WSIs) that include pixel-level masks of benign and malignant epithelium for segmentation model development.

The HuBMAP Kaggle 2020 challenge dataset consists of 15 human kidney PAS-stained whole slide images (WSIs) with 3,785 glomerulus segmentation masks for training, along with 5 validation and 10 test WSIs, designed for glomerulus segmentation tasks.
A collection of 30 PAS-stained human kidney whole-slide images (11 fresh-frozen, 9 FFPE), featuring 7,102 segmented glomeruli with annotated masks.

A fully annotated skin histology dataset comprising 38 H&E-stained whole slide images with pixel-wise segmentation and pixel-level annotations for 12 tissue classes, including skin layers, anatomical structures, carcinoma subtypes, and background.
25,000 H&E color image patches (768×768 px) of lung and colon tissues, evenly split into five classes for cancer detection.

A paired image dataset comprising approximately 90,000 paired patches of H&E and IHC (ER, PR, HER2, Ki67) from around 240 breast cancer whole slide images (WSIs), labeled for marker status, designed for receptor status prediction in breast cancer.

A dataset consisting of 277,524 RGB image patches (50×50 pixels) extracted from 162 whole-slide images (WSIs) of breast cancer tissue, with each patch labeled as either IDC-positive or IDC-negative for the presence of invasive ductal carcinoma.
A dataset of approximately 500,000 labeled nuclei in colon histology regions, annotated for both instance segmentation and classification.
Immunofluorescence whole slide images (WSIs) of rodent liver, kidney, and stomach tissues for autoimmune disease screening, annotated with four class labels.

dataset_name: Leukemia and B-ALL Hematogones Blood Smear Dataset
description: Approximately 1,000 Wright-Giemsa stained blood smear images, evenly distributed among four different leukemia types.

A publicly released dataset of 200 FFPE H&E-stained colorectal biopsy whole-slide images (WSIs), each with extensive pathologist-provided region of interest (ROI) annotations for 10 pathological findings, including dysplasia and adenocarcinoma.
~23,199 H&E-stained lung cancer image patches labeled into nine distinct tissue classes.
30 H&E-stained image tiles (1000×1000 px) of nuclei from 8 organs, containing 21,623 manually annotated nuclei, for developing generalized nuclei segmentation.

dataset_name: MBM (Modified Bone Marrow) Cell Counting Dataset
description: Bone marrow H&E stained microscope images with dot annotations for nuclei detection benchmarking.
Multiplex CD3/CD8 immunohistochemistry (IHC) whole slide images (WSIs) with patches labeled according to T-lymphocyte count bins.
A weakly supervised dataset of H&E whole slide images (WSIs) for lung adenocarcinoma tissue segmentation, featuring both patch-level and limited pixel-level annotations.
A collection of 691 high-resolution lung histology images categorized into seven classes based on differentiation status.

This dataset contains 27,558 segmented thin blood smear cytology images of red blood cells (RBCs), stained with Wright–Giemsa, from the NIH LHNCBC. Each image is labeled as either parasitized or uninfected, with equal representation of both categories.
Breast lymph node whole slide images (WSIs) from the Camelyon challenge, including slide-level labels and partial region annotations.

dataset_name: METU-CCTGS Colorectal Cancer Tumor Grade Segmentation Dataset
description: Colorectal cancer whole slide images (WSIs) with pixel-wise tumor grade annotations for segmentation.

dataset_name: MONKEY Transplant and Kidney Inflammation Challenge dataset
description: PAS-stained kidney transplant biopsy whole slide images (WSIs) with region of interest (ROI) annotations for the detection of monocytes and lymphocytes.

This dataset comprises H&E-stained histopathology image patches from multiple tumor organs, annotated with nuclei boundaries for segmentation tasks. It includes 30 training patches (~1000×1000 px, ~21,600 nuclei) and 14 test images spanning 7 organ types. Released as part of the MICCAI 2018 MoNuSeg challenge, the dataset is designed to advance and benchmark generalizable nucleus segmentation methods.

Multi-organ nuclei segmentation and classification dataset from H&E-stained images of four organs (breast, kidney, lung, and prostate), featuring manual segmentations and classifications of approximately 46,000 nuclei across four cell types (epithelial, lymphocyte, macrophage, neutrophil) from 71 patients, as released via the MoNuSAC 2020 challenge.

This dataset consists of approximately 130,000 H&E-stained whole slide image (WSI) patches from 8 cancer subtypes, including DLBCL, with nuclear segmentation annotations, curated for pan-cancer studies and multi-class tumor classification tasks.
Colorectal polyp image patches labeled as hyperplastic or adenomatous for classification.

218,578 H&E-stained image patches (224×224 at 0.5 µm/px) derived from TCGA stomach adenocarcinoma slides, each representing tumor regions and labeled for microsatellite stability status as either MSS or MSI.

dataset_name: MLBC-Mendeley LBC Cervical Cancer (Pap Smear) dataset
description: Liquid-based Pap smear images labeled with Bethesda cytology classifications across four distinct classes.

This dataset contains 193,312 H&E-stained image patches (224×224 pixels at 0.5 µm/px) extracted from TCGA colorectal cancer slides, each labeled for microsatellite stability status as either microsatellite stable (MSS) or microsatellite instable (MSI).

dataset_name: Multi-Scanner Canine Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma Histopathology Dataset
description: H&E whole slide image (WSI) dataset of canine cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (SCC), featuring 44 tissue samples each digitized on five different scanners to investigate scanner-related domain shift, with multi-class tumor and tissue annotations.

dataset_name: Multi-Scanner Canine Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma Histopathology Dataset
description: H&E whole slide image (WSI) dataset of canine cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (SCC), featuring 44 tissue samples each digitized on five different scanners to investigate scanner-related domain shift, with multi-class tumor and tissue annotations.

dataset_name: NSCLC TCGA Whole Slide Image Collection
description: TCGA NSCLC H&E whole slide images (WSIs) for mutation prediction studies.

This interactive segmentation dataset focuses on lymphocyte detection in IHC histology, comprising 871 image patches (256×256 px) extracted from 440 whole slide images (WSIs) of various tissues. Each patch includes a binary mask for lymphocyte nuclei, annotated using an interactive annotation framework. The dataset is split into 671 training and 200 validation images, making it suitable for developing and evaluating interactive segmentation models for WBC and IHC lymphocytes.

The NuCLS breast cancer nuclei dataset contains approximately 220,000 labeled nuclei from 3,944 regions of interest (ROIs) across 125 TCGA breast cancer patients. Each nucleus is annotated with a class label (13 categories, including tumor, fibroblast, lymphocyte, etc.), a bounding box, and a polygon segmentation mask, supporting classification, detection, and segmentation tasks for multi-task training in breast histology.

OpenPath is the largest public pathology image–text dataset, comprising approximately 208,414 pathology images paired with expert-written captions that were crowdsourced from medical social media. Spanning multiple tissue types and pathologies, this dataset provides high-quality expert-captioned images and enables the training of vision–language models in the field of pathology.

OpenSRH is a stimulated Raman histology (SRH) dataset for brain tumors, featuring over 1,300 SRH whole-slide images (WSIs) from more than 300 brain tumor cases—including gliomas, meningiomas, and metastases. Each image is accompanied by tumor segmentation masks and expert pathologist annotations, providing paired labels to support intraoperative brain tumor diagnosis research with high-resolution SRH optical images.
This dataset contains whole slide images (WSIs) of mouse and rat kidney glomeruli, featuring approximately 21,000 annotated glomeruli.

ORCHID is a large oral cancer histology image database containing approximately 300,000 H&E-stained image patches, including normal oral mucosa, oral submucous fibrosis (precancer), and oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) with well-, moderately-, and poorly-differentiated subtypes. This comprehensive dataset enables the development of AI models for the diagnosis of oral cancer and precancer.

1,144 histology image tiles (H&E stained, 1024×1024 pixels at 10× magnification) from osteosarcoma resection specimens, derived from 4 patients' slides, and labeled as Non-Tumor, Viable Tumor, or Necrotic Tumor. These images are intended for evaluating tumor viability in the context of treatment response.

Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E) stained whole slide images (WSIs) of liver cancer from the PAIP 2019 challenge, provided for tumor segmentation and burden estimation. The dataset includes 50 training WSIs, 10 validation WSIs, and 40 test WSIs, each with annotated tumor regions in the form of binary masks. All slides were scanned at 20× magnification using an Aperio AT2 scanner.

This dataset comprises 240 H&E-stained whole slide images (WSIs) from colon, prostate, and pancreas tissues, collected for the PAIP 2021 multi-organ tumor segmentation challenge. The collection includes 150 training, 30 validation, and 60 test slides, all scanned at 20× magnification using a Leica Aperio AT2 scanner. Each WSI features ground-truth tumor annotations in XML format, with additional perineural invasion annotations, enabling comprehensive multi-organ cancer analysis.
A Kaggle challenge focused on prostate cancer grade assessment, featuring approximately 12,600 whole slide images (WSIs) for Gleason grading.

dataset_name: Pan-tumor Pan-cancer Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocyte (TIL) Patch Dataset
description: A comprehensive dataset for tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) detection, comprising multi-organ immunohistochemistry (IHC) images with exhaustive CD3+ T-cell annotations and a large collection of 304,097 pan-cancer H&E image patches (100×100 px) from 23 TCGA tumor types, each labeled for the presence or absence of TILs (≥2 vs none).

This training subset of the PANDA prostate cancer grading dataset includes 10,616 H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) with corresponding ISUP grade (Gleason group) annotations for each slide (ranging from 0 to 5).

An open pan-cancer nuclei segmentation and classification dataset comprising 7,904 H&E image patches (256×256) from 19 tissue types, featuring instance masks for approximately 205,000 annotated nuclei categorized into five classes (neoplastic, inflammatory, connective, dead, epithelial).

A breast cancer panoptic segmentation dataset comprising 1,709 H&E ROIs from 151 TCGA patients, featuring integrated region-level (tissue compartment) and cell-level (nuclei instance) annotations—including 814,886 nuclei masks—designed for tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL) assessment and comprehensive analysis of the tumor microenvironment.

A benchmark patch-based dataset of 327,680 color image patches (96×96) extracted from Camelyon16 H&E whole-slide images of lymph nodes, labeled for the presence of metastatic breast cancer, intended for lymph node metastasis classification.

A dataset of approximately 262,000 H&E-stained image patches (300×300 px) extracted from 991 stomach adenocarcinoma biopsy whole-slide images (WSIs), each paired with a diagnostic caption from the pathology report. The dataset covers 9 gastric adenocarcinoma subtypes and a 3-grade subset, and is designed for histopathology image captioning and related AI tasks.

A gastric adenocarcinoma pathology patch dataset containing 262,777 H&E image patches (300×300) from 991 whole-slide endoscopic biopsy specimens, each paired with a pathologist-written English text description of the histopathological findings.

This dataset consists of 89,996 H&E-stained image patches (28×28 pixels) derived from colorectal cancer whole-slide images (NCT-CRC-HE-100K), categorized into 9 tissue classes (adipose, background, debris, lymphocytes, mucus, smooth muscle, normal mucosa, cancer-associated stroma, tumor epithelium), and is provided as part of the MedMNIST collection for 9-class colorectal tissue classification.

The Prostate Epithelium Segmentation Test Set consists of 40 H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) with expert-annotated masks, forming the test portion of the PESO prostate epithelium segmentation dataset. Each WSI contains selected 2500×2500 px regions annotated for epithelium outlines, with ground truth provided as XML polygon outlines and corresponding region images to support segmentation evaluation.

The PESO prostate epithelium segmentation training dataset contains 62 H&E-stained prostate whole slide images (WSIs) with corresponding epithelium segmentation masks. The masks were generated using IHC dual-staining (p63 & CK8/18) and include corrected annotations for training purposes. Slides are provided as pyramidal TIFFs at 0.48 µm/px resolution, with separate mask files.

A multimodal dataset of 28 prostate cancer patients comprising 3T mpMRI scans (T2-weighted, DWI, DCE) and co-registered H&E-stained pseudo-whole mount histology sections with detailed cancer extent annotations. The MRI and histology whole slide images (WSIs) are spatially aligned to enable accurate tumor delineation and mapping of tumor foci.

Multiparametric prostate MRI (3T, T1/T2/DWI/DCE) and matched whole-mount H&E histopathology from 28 prostatectomy cases, featuring co-registered MRI and digitized pathology with tumor extent annotations and registration for radiology-pathology correlation and Gleason grading development.
This dataset contains images of cervical cells from Pap smears, organized into different classes to facilitate machine learning approaches for automated screening.

This dataset comprises 5,759 H&E-stained whole-slide prostate biopsy images (WSIs) from 1,243 patients collected at Radboud UMC, as used in the Gleason 2019 Challenge/Kaggle PANDA. Each slide includes pathologist-assigned ISUP Grade Group (1–5) labels and pixel-wise Gleason annotations, supporting the development of automated Gleason grading algorithms.

A large vision–language pathology dataset comprising over 1 million pathology image–text pairs, including 1,000+ whole-slide images from various organs and approximately 4.3 million spatially localized sub-image text pairs. Sourced from educational videos (such as YouTube pathology videos), tweets, and papers, the dataset provides diverse sub-image regions paired with textual descriptions (via ASR and LLM), supporting model pretraining and foundation model training in pathology.

A comprehensive histopathology dataset featuring 1,500 H&E-stained images of prostate and colorectal tissues, each with manual gland instance segmentation annotations for precise delineation of glandular structures and lumen. The dataset includes images from prostate and colon adenocarcinoma slides, with detailed outlines to facilitate automated gland segmentation and morphology analysis, and is intended for use alongside datasets such as GlaS and CRAG.

A collection of H&E-stained synovial tissue images from 170 rheumatoid arthritis (RA) patients, used for quantification of inflammation and histologic subtyping in the AMP RA Phase II study. This dataset includes whole-slide images with corresponding molecular (RNA-seq) data and expert assessments of inflammatory features, such as lymphoid versus myeloid patterns, providing a comprehensive resource for studying synovial pathology in RA.
TCGA LUAD whole slide images (WSIs) segmented into 9 tissue classes across image patches.

This dataset includes 1,770 gastric biopsy regions of interest (ROIs) with expert segmentation masks for gastric cancer detection, as well as a skin pathology image dataset from the 2nd Jiangsu Big Data Competition containing H&E whole-slide images of three common non-melanoma skin lesions (intradermal nevus, seborrheic keratosis, and basal cell carcinoma) with detailed lesion region annotations (masks) to facilitate stain-invariant lesion classification.

This dataset contains 775 microscope images of peripheral blood cells stained with Jenner–Giemsa for plasma cell segmentation in multiple myeloma. Each image includes corresponding nucleus and cytoplasm masks and is split into training (298 images), validation (200 images), and test (277 images) sets.

SegPath is a large histology segmentation dataset comprising 158,687 H&E image patches (~984×984 px each) collected from 18 organs, each with corresponding binary segmentation masks for 8 cell/tissue classes (such as epithelial and immune cells). The masks, derived from IF restaining of the H&E images, enable semantic segmentation of specific cell types and tissues.

A prostate biopsy image dataset comprising 155 digitized H&E whole slide images (WSIs) with pixel-wise Gleason pattern masks (patterns 3, 4, 5) and slide-level ISUP Gleason score labels (Mendeley SICAP v2), enabling the development of automated Gleason grading models.
Canine squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) whole slide images (WSIs) scanned using multiple scanners, with polygon annotations for seven distinct tissue and lesion classes.

A dataset of 190 microscopic bone marrow aspirate smear images for B-lineage Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (B-ALL) versus Multiple Myeloma (MM) classification, containing images of B-ALL and MM cells with nuclei segmentation annotations (in related works). The dataset is designed to support the evaluation of stain normalization algorithms and the development of stain-invariant classification and segmentation methods.

A dataset of 190 microscopic bone marrow aspirate smear images for B-lineage Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (B-ALL) versus Multiple Myeloma (MM) classification, containing images of B-ALL and MM cells with nuclei segmentation annotations (in related works). The dataset is designed to support the evaluation of stain normalization algorithms and the development of stain-invariant classification and segmentation methods.

A dataset of 61 whole slide images (WSIs) of H&E-stained spitzoid melanocytic tumors from 58 patients, labeled as benign Spitz nevus, atypical Spitz tumor (STUMP), or spitzoid melanoma, accompanied by an Excel file containing patient clinical metadata.

This dataset contains approximately 3,700 H&E microscope image patches (512×512) sourced from 96 whole slide images (WSIs), including 64 post-neoadjuvant therapy (NAT) breast tumor slides, designed for tumor cellularity quantification (0–100%). Each patch is labeled with a pathologist-estimated tumor cellularity percentage and is part of the SPIE-AAPM-NCI BreastPathQ Challenge.
Skin pathological image dataset containing annotated lesion areas for IDN, SK, and BCC.
Whole slide images (WSIs) featuring spatial transcriptomics spots that connect H&E histology with gene expression data.

A landmark cancer genomics program providing multi-omics and clinical data on approximately 11,000 patients across 33 cancer types, featuring over 20,000 diagnostic H&E-stained whole-slide images (WSIs) from the TCGA Digital Slide Archive spanning 32 cancer types; these images are paired with comprehensive genomic and clinical data, enabling integrative analyses of cancer biology.

The TCGA Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma (TCGA-BLCA) dataset includes approximately 400 H&E whole slide images (WSIs) of bladder urothelial carcinoma, representing around 412 cases, along with linked genomic data. This resource is available for research on bladder cancer morphology and genomics.

The TCGA Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma & Endocervical Adenocarcinoma (TCGA-CESC) dataset contains approximately 300 H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) of cervical and endocervical carcinoma from around 307 patients, providing a resource for studying cervical cancer histology with linked molecular data.

The TCGA Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA-BRCA) cohort comprises genomic and clinical data alongside approximately 1,100 publicly available H&E stained whole slide images (WSIs) of breast carcinoma across various subtypes, enabling diagnostic validation and computational studies.

The TCGA Colon Adenocarcinoma (TCGA-COAD) dataset comprises approximately 450 H&E whole slide images (WSIs) of colorectal adenocarcinoma from around 459 cases, along with corresponding genomic data, enabling computational pathology studies that correlate histopathological features with genomic alterations.
A web-based platform hosting approximately 24,000 TCGA pathology whole-slide images (WSIs) across 32 cancer types, enabling interactive viewing and integration with TCGA genomic and clinical data.
Combined TCGA colorectal cohort comprising genomic data and approximately 1,000 H&E whole-slide images from around 600 patients with colon adenocarcinoma and rectal adenocarcinoma.
The TCGA Esophageal Carcinoma dataset comprises H&E-stained whole slide images of esophageal carcinoma, including both squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma subtypes.

The TCGA Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBC) dataset includes multi-omics data and 48 H&E-stained whole slide images (WSIs) of lymphoma pathology slides, representing diagnostic biopsies from approximately 48 patients, and is available for research on lymphoma histopathology.
The TCGA Stomach Adenocarcinoma (TCGA-STAD) dataset includes genomic data and H&E whole slide images (WSIs).
Whole slide images (WSIs) of glioblastoma and lower-grade glioma cases from TCGA, providing brain tumor pathology data.
Whole slide images (WSIs) of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma from the TCGA dataset, consisting of H&E-stained diagnostic slides.

The TCGA Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma cohort comprises approximately 530 H&E whole-slide images from nephrectomy specimens of around 537 patients, providing a public reference set of histopathology images for clear cell renal cell carcinoma with matched genomic data.
TCGA Kidney Renal Papillary Cell Carcinoma (KIRP) dataset consisting of whole slide images (WSIs) of H&E-stained FFPE tumor sections.
Digital H&E whole-slide images of liver hepatocellular carcinoma cases from TCGA (approximately 491 WSIs from ~349 patients), linked to corresponding genomic data.
Whole-slide images from approximately 150 bone marrow core biopsy slides of TCGA acute myeloid leukemia cases.

The TCGA Prostate Adenocarcinoma (TCGA-PRAD) collection includes 333 H&E whole slide images (WSIs) of prostate adenocarcinoma, along with comprehensive genomic, epigenomic, and clinical data, supporting integrative cancer research.
Whole-slide H&E images of prostate adenocarcinoma cases from TCGA, comprising approximately 500 WSIs from around 500 patients, are linked to comprehensive genomic and clinical data.
H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) of cutaneous melanoma cases from TCGA, including several hundred slides from both primary and metastatic skin melanomas, were used for survival and subtype studies.
Computed tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) probability and density heatmaps for 4,759 TCGA H&E whole slide images (WSIs) across 13 cancer types.
Computed tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) density heatmaps for 5,202 TCGA H&E whole slide images (WSIs) across 13 cancer types (73.4 GB).
H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) of uterine corpus endometrial carcinoma cases from TCGA (~540 WSIs), used for subtype and outcome studies.

dataset_name: TCGA-TIL WSI Slides for TIL Analysis
